ev.q: Patients were more likely than non-ill park visitors to have been exposed to water from a splash feature
Fifty (32%) of 154 attendees had illness meeting the clinical (n = 45) or confirmed (n = 5) case definition
The investigation revealed five immunofluorescence assay (IFA)-confirmed and 45 clinically compatible cases
Patients were more likely to have been exposed to splash-feature water only than were non-ill persons
The investigation revealed five immunofluorescence assay (IFA)-confirmed and 45 clinically compatible cases
A retrospective cohort analysis was used to identify risk factors for illness

methods_quotes.q: A retrospective cohort analysis was used to identify risk factors for illness, after combining confirmed and clinical cases.
household contacts who also had visited the municipal park were excluded if they reported exposure to the splash park after August 4
